messages:
Lena (AE): Jin's team requires an on-prem POC image freeze for 6 months and an offline hotfix delivery plan.
Marco (SE): We can support a freeze + signed hotfixes, but need delivery channel and SLA clarified.
Jin (Customer): Delivery will be to an airgapped jumpbox via scp or hand-delivered USB. No telemetry or callbacks allowed.
Rhea (Legal): We'll need SOW language for number of hotfixes, SLA, and liability limits.
Marco (SE): Ops notes: pre-stage Notary keys, produce signed manifest + bundle, include verify and rollback commands. Example: `notary verify --signature manifest.sig` and `sha256sum -c manifest.json`.
Lena (AE): Commercially propose a freeze retainer + per-hotfix fee; include optional 48h fast-track for extra cost.
Jin (Customer): 72h standard SLA is acceptable. Include chain-of-custody manifest on delivery.
Marco (SE): We'll draft the runbook and a manifest template. Need sec contact for handoff.
Lena (AE): Action items: Marco runbook, Rhea SOW clause, Jin to provide sec-ops contact.
Jin (Customer): I'll send sec-ops email by EOD. Thanks.
